description: Historical time series behind the Global Markets dashboard, often decades long: equity indices, central-bank policy rates, 10-year government bond yields, FX rates, oil/gas/gold/copper, VIX, DXY, the US 2s10s curve, and per-country macro indicators (GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, house prices, credit gap, debt, confidence, macro stress). Address a series by historyCode (from get_global_markets_overview, get_country_macro or get_macro_indicators), by instrument name ("Fed", "Brent", "Germany 10Y", "S&P 500"), or by indicator + country. Returns summary statistics (latest, change over 1M/3M/1Y/5Y, range, where the latest sits in the window) plus resampled points. Use for "how have rates moved since 2022", "plot Brent over 10 years", "is German unemployment rising". Read-only.

code.description: Exact series code from another tool's historyCode field (e.g. "CNBC_US10Y", "BIS_CBPOL_US", "UNEMPLOYMENT:Germany", "YAHOO_GSPC").

indicator.description: Or a per-country macro indicator, together with country (same keys as get_macro_indicators).

instrument.description: Or a market name: an index ("S&P 500", "DAX", "Nikkei 225"), commodity ("Brent", "Gold"), FX pair ("EUR/USD"), central bank ("Fed", "ECB", "BoE"), 10Y yield ("Germany 10Y", "US 10Y"), or headline series ("VIX", "DXY", "2s10s", "global inflation").

interval.description: Resample to end-of-period values. auto = the finest interval that fits maxPoints.

maxPoints.description: Upper bound on returned points (auto interval only; an explicit interval is truncated to the most recent maxPoints).

name: get_macro_history
title: Get macro / market history
